transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I’m here because I feel like I’m always running hot, like I can’t shut the motor off. And lately it’s been getting me in trouble at the firehouse, so… I figured I should talk to somebody.
Have there been times when you felt unusually high, euphoric, or on top of the world?
I don’t think so. I mean, I get wound up or keyed up, but not like euphoric or “on top of the world.” At least nothing I’d describe that way.
When you’re feeling especially keyed up, do you need less sleep than usual?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I suddenly need less sleep, exactly. I might have trouble settling down sometimes, but I still feel like I need the sleep.
Have you been using stimulants like methamphetamine, cocaine, or non-prescribed ADHD pills?
No, not that I can think of. I haven’t been using meth or cocaine or taking ADHD pills that aren’t prescribed to me.
Did these restless, always-on feelings start back when you were a child?

Yeah, I think so. My mom has said I was like this back in grade school too—always getting out of my seat, blurting out answers, losing homework. I’d get notes sent home, even though I was apparently smart enough to do the work.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying, even when there isn’t a clear reason to?
I don’t know. I mean, I worry about normal stuff, but I’m not sure I’d say it’s a lot or for no reason. It’s not something I’ve really tracked.
Do you often have trouble focusing on tasks, even when you’re not feeling worried?

Yeah. Even when I’m not worried, I’ll be in a briefing or doing drone training, and I’m good for the first few minutes. Then I’ll realize I’ve just been staring at the map or the screen and missed half of what command said.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about a lot of different things?
Not really, no. I mean, I worry about things when there’s a real reason, but I wouldn’t say I’m constantly worrying about a bunch of different stuff.
